title: CI exact checkout provenance and pull-request stale-run cancellation

phases.objective: Bind Recovery test progress artifacts to the exact Git tree actually checked out and cancel only superseded pull-request CI runs so obsolete heads cannot serialize ahead of the current candidate while push and workflow-dispatch verification remain non-cancellable.

e2e_journeys.actor: CI evidence publisher and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: CI and CI Pull Request Recovery concurrency plus the Recovery Unit & Integration Tests job
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The test suite starts only after the checked-out SHA matches the selected candidate; structured progress reports expose that same checked-out SHA; and a newer pull-request synchronization cancels obsolete PR runs without making push or workflow-dispatch runs cancellable.
steps: Checkout the selected pull-request head SHA or explicit workflow-dispatch SHA.
Resolve git rev-parse HEAD immediately before the Recovery test suite.
Reject any mismatch between the checked-out SHA and the selected candidate SHA.
Run npm test with process-local GITHUB_SHA bound to the verified checked-out SHA.
Use the pull-request event predicate as the only cancel-in-progress authority for CI and Recovery.
Keep push and workflow-dispatch verification outside cancellation authority.
Upload ordered test progress reports without relabeling head execution as a different merge candidate.
assertions: Recovery reports cannot inherit a different event-level GITHUB_SHA after exact-head checkout.
A candidate identity mismatch fails before npm test.
Superseded pull-request runs are cancellable in both CI workflows.
Push and workflow-dispatch runs are not unconditionally cancellable.
No repository write, protected-ref mutation, provider call, deployment, database action, migration, credential access, or external send is introduced.
The Recovery workflow retains read-only contents permission.

phases.objective: Publish the verified checkout identity and superseded-run cancellation reason as explicit typed fields across all CI evidence families.
Prove identity preservation and current-head selection across reruns, workflow dispatch, pull-request synchronize events, and cancelled/restarted jobs.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction has no provider canary authority.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction grants no Production or deployment authority.
